usedFor: PDFGate holds signed envelopes and HubSpot holds deals, so “Envelope Completed” can run “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Envelope Completed” in PDFGate, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A completed envelope opens a deal record, so signed paperwork shows up in the pipeline.

watchOut: The catalog describes “Envelope Completed” as envelope created, so test which event fires before “Create Deal” relies on it.
